TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Irou ka mou-mha ta Mei-rang, ka ni-'illing-han ki Fa-riseen, ka masa'un mabatoung ta ni-pa-Pahtatæutæuu-han ta ni-'uloug-han-appa ti Jesus ti Joan-nes-an.
S.TRANSL: When therefore the LORD knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
主知道法利賽人聽見他收門徒，施洗，比約翰還多，（

S.FORM: (Meita ka assi ni-taeu-ma-do-en ti Jesus, râ ki Pahtatæutæuu-han tyn.)
S.TRANSL: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
其實不是耶穌親自施洗，乃是他的門徒施洗，）

S.FORM: Anna-ta ni-darang-en tyn tou Judæa, ka ni-salikough mou-qua tou Galilæa.
S.TRANSL: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.
他就離了猶太，又往加利利去。

S.FORM: Ka kidi ka tau-qu'-eih tyn mali-deu'ua tou Samarien,
S.TRANSL: And he must needs go through Samaria.
必須經過撒馬利亞，

S.FORM: Anna-ta ni-iroua tou euma ki Samarien ka Sihgar ta ni-pana-nang-an tyn, tou tamang ki mah-koul to'k ka na pæp'æ̈ ti Jakob ki alak tyn ka paræh ka ti Josef.
S.TRANSL: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
於是到了撒馬利亞的一座城，名叫敘加，靠近雅各給他兒子約瑟的那塊地。

S.FORM: Ka akoumea hynna ta na tassyk ti Jacob. Irou-ra ka siba ta ti Jesus ki ni-oudadarang-en tyn, annata itoutouk-ato myrroung ki tassyk. Ka tou hivat-ato ki ka annum ki tæ̈ 'lei da.
S.TRANSL: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
在那裏有雅各井；耶穌因走路困乏，就坐在井旁。那時約有午正。

S.FORM: Ka ni-iroua ta Ina ka makka Samarien mou-rau-raloum. Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, pa-ytt-â jau-an-nda.
S.TRANSL: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
有一個撒馬利亞的婦人來打水。耶穌對她說：「請你給我水喝。」（

S.FORM: (Ka ni-d'marang ta Pahtatæutæu-'han tyn mu-euma, ka peil-auh nein ki kakang-in-da.)
S.TRANSL: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
那時門徒進城買食物去了。）

S.FORM: Anna-ta ni-k'ma tyni-æn ta Ina ka makka Samarien, Tou-mimia-en-hou ka Jode-kow ma-ma ki mang, ki pa-yt-au-mau-kow, ka ynna-koh ka makka Sa-maria? Dou äoussi ki saou-saäl-en ki poungas ta Joden ki Samari-tanen.
S.TRANSL: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
撒馬利亞的婦人對他說：「你既是猶太人，怎麼向我一個撒馬利亞婦人要水喝呢？」原來猶太人和撒馬利亞人沒有來往。

S.FORM: Nda ni-mattæ'i-vli ta ti Jesus k'ma tyni-æn, Heirou k'a-lang-en-hou lava ta na pæp-'æ ki Alid, ti-mang-appa ta teni, ka masasousou ymhou-an, Pa-yht-ou-koh ynna kow t'ou-mimia tyni-æn, ka pi-'æl-ato ymhou-an ki raloum ka mæuægh.
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
耶穌回答說：「你若知道上帝的恩賜，和對你說『給我水喝』的是誰，你必早求他，他也必早給了你活水。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ina tyni-an, Meirang, ä'oussi kow ki atug' ka malæu'u ta daouk nda, makka kounna ymhou-an ta raloum ka mæu'ægh?
S.TRANSL: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
婦人說：「先生，沒有打水的器具，井又深，你從哪裏得活水呢？

S.FORM: Si-ouro' kow kaua tou kei-rang-en ki na Rama-jan ka ti Ja-cob, ka na pæp-'æ tyn ymiæn-æn ta daouk k'atta? ka ni-yht-ten tyn tou atta, ki alalak tyn, ki laula-oung-appa tyn.
S.TRANSL: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
我們的祖宗雅各將這井留給我們，他自己和兒子並牲畜也都喝這井裏的水，難道你比他還大嗎？」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-vli ta ti Jesus k'ma tyni-æn, Ti-mamang ta myt ki raloum ka atta, milala-âl-appa meittou.
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
耶穌回答說：「凡喝這水的還要再渴；

S.FORM: Râ ti-mang ta myht-âl-ato ki raloum ka phæ-en-ei-mau ty-ni-æn, assi meittou-ah tou yhka-quan myddarynnouh, nda ra-loum ka phæ-æn-ei-mau tyni-æn, kæuh-tassyk-âl-ato tyni-æn ki raloum ka l'bboar tou kæuag-an touhan ka myh-kâqua myddaryn-nouh.
S.TRANSL: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
人若喝我所賜的水就永遠不渴。我所賜的水要在他裏頭成為泉源，直湧到永生。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma tyni-æn ta ina, Meirang, p'hei-koh ki raloum k'anna, kou assi-ah-koh mi-lala meittou, ka assi-mau ou-qua-auh hiä mou-rauraloum.
S.TRANSL: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
婦人說：「先生，請把這水賜給我，叫我不渴，也不用來這麼遠打水。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Ou-qu'-au tætææm-au ta tboung oho ka mou-qua hia.
S.TRANSL: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
耶穌說：「你去叫你丈夫也到這裏來。」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-vli ta ina ka ni-k'ma, Äoussi-koh ki tboung. Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Ma-riang ta sou oho', Äoussi-koh ki tboung.
S.TRANSL: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
婦人說：「我沒有丈夫。」耶穌說：「你說沒有丈夫是不錯的。

S.FORM: Ka ni-akoumea kow ra-rymma ki tboung, ra ka akou-mea kow hnyn assi tboung-oho ka d'lligh, matiktik ta sou-oho k'anna.
S.TRANSL: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
你已經有五個丈夫，你現在有的並不是你的丈夫。你這話是真的。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ina tyni-æn, Meirang, kmytta-koh ka Tama-Mattæ'i-tan kow.
S.TRANSL: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
婦人說：「先生，我看出你是先知。

S.FORM: Ni-reihp-en tmamud ki na Ramama-jan tou voukkyn k'atta, râ ymoumi ta k'ma, ka tou Jerusalem ta i-tou-qu'-an ki reihp-en tmamud.
S.TRANSL: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
我們的祖宗在這山上禮拜，你們倒說，應當禮拜的地方是在耶路撒冷。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyniæn, Ina tna-'msing-â jau-an yrou-a ta kidi ki tæ'læi, ka reihp-ei-moumi tmamud ta Rama assi tou voukkyn k'atta, assi-appa tou Jerusalem.
S.TRANSL: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
耶穌說：「婦人，你當信我。時候將到，你們拜父，也不在這山上，也不在耶路撒冷。

S.FORM: Reip-kamou tmamud ta ymoumi ki assi-moumi kavan-an: reip-kame tmamud ta ymi-æn ki kavana-nien: ka makka-qua ki Joden ta karariang-an.
S.TRANSL: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
你們所拜的，你們不知道；我們所拜的，我們知道，因為救恩是從猶太人出來的。

S.FORM: Râ, iroua ta [kidi ki] tæ'-lei, ka hnyn anna-un ta anna, ka reihp-ah tmamud ki Rarâm-an ta Tama-t'amud ka d'llig tou Joep-än tou ka d'llig-an da: Ka k'i'ym-en ki Rama ta k'ma-hynna, deip tmamud tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
時候將到，如今就是了，那真正拜父的，要用心靈和誠實拜他，因為父要這樣的人拜他。」

S.FORM: Joep-an ta Alid, na ma-mang ta reip tmamud tyni-æn, deip-ah tmamud ta neni tou Joep-an tou kadilhgan appa.
S.TRANSL: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
上帝是個靈，所以拜他的必須用心靈和誠實拜他。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ina tyni-æn, Kavanna-en-nau ka Irroua ta Messias (ka sioua ti Christus) ka rou Irrou-âl-ato ta teni, anna ta ginnau-ah bannavanna ymi-æn-æn.
S.TRANSL: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
婦人說：「我知道彌賽亞（就是那稱為基督的）要來；他來了，必將一切的事都告訴我們。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, ti jau ta ti atta, ka mâktavæh ymhou-an.
S.TRANSL: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
耶穌說：「這和你說話的就是他！」

S.FORM: Ka ni-yrroua mei-vavalei ki akou sou ta Pahtatæutæu-en tyn, ka mou-ryng-hgau-'ato ki patætætævæh tyn ki ina; Ra assi ni-k'ma ta ti-mamang, M'ang ta talirali' ohou? Mang lava, ta pat-tæ'i-tatavæh oho' tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
當下門徒回來，就希奇耶穌和一個婦人說話；只是沒有人說：「你是要甚麼？」或說：「你為甚麼和她說話？」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-atta-ral-len ki Ina ta atugh tyn, ka ni-d'marang meu-'uma mattæi kma-hyn, na ki ta'u,
S.TRANSL: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
那婦人就留下水罐子，往城裏去，對眾人說：

S.FORM: . Nda, ou-qu-a k'ytt-ei ta tæu ka ni-banna-vanna jau-an ymmid ki na ringei-au: Assi kaua ti Christus ta ti anna?
S.TRANSL: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
「你們來看！有一個人將我素來所行的一切事都給我說出來了，莫非這就是基督嗎？」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-'tpæpænæh ki ni-pakka-eum'æn ta neni iroua tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
眾人就出城，往耶穌那裏去。

S.FORM: Tou ptakikidi k'anna ni-'nmahi ta Pahtatæutæu-en tyn tyni-æn k'ma, Rabbi, mavok-â.
S.TRANSL: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
這其間，門徒對耶穌說：「拉比，請吃。」

S.FORM: Râ ni-k'ma ta teni neini-æn, Akou kakannin-koh ki kan-nau-mau, k'assi-moumi 'ou-m'han.
S.TRANSL: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
耶穌說：「我有食物吃，是你們不知道的。」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-mattæ'i-nau-nado mattæ'i-tavæh ki sou ta Pæhtatæutæu-æn, Ni-mad kaua ta ti-maman' ki k'an-n-auh tyn?
S.TRANSL: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
門徒就彼此對問說：「莫非有人拿甚麼給他吃嗎？」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus neini-æn, K'a kan-au-mau ta anna ka pam't-au-mau ta kamoei-in ki ni-madingi jau-an, ka pei-mouhga-au-mau ta ring-ei tyn.
S.TRANSL: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
耶穌說：「我的食物就是遵行差我來者的旨意，做成他的工。

S.FORM: Assi-kamou kaua mattæ'i-kma-hynna ki sou, Pahpat appa ta voural, anna ta irouâ ta 'ajam-mæn? Kmyttâ-ato, pasousou-koun-nau-kamou-ra, pa-pa-sa'u-vavaua ki matta-oumi mararau ki dapoudap: ka mapoulé-ato tou 'ajam-eih hnyn.
S.TRANSL: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
你們豈不說『到收割的時候還有四個月』嗎？我告訴你們，舉目向田觀看，莊稼已經熟了，可以收割了。

S.FORM: Ka ti-mang ta maajam mara ki than ki ouvavarg-han ka uld-den tyn ki voua tou kæuag-han ka myhkaqua myddarynnouh, alei ka ma-saal-lah marai ta dmierri ki maajam.
S.TRANSL: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
收割的人得工價，積蓄五穀到永生，叫撒種的和收割的一同快樂。

S.FORM: Ka dilligh tou atta ma-tiktik ta sou kanna, Pani ta dmier-ri, pani appa ta na ajam.
S.TRANSL: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
俗語說：『那人撒種，這人收割』，這話可見是真的。

S.FORM: Ni-padingi-en-au-kamou paajam ki assi-moumi ni-ou-m'-an mapoungas: ra pani ta ni [mouma] mapoungas, ka ni-sahkaqua-noumi ki ni-ou-ma'an nein mapoungas.
S.TRANSL: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
我差你們去收你們所沒有勞苦的；別人勞苦，你們享受他們所勞苦的。」

S.FORM: Ka mabatoung ki Samari-tanen ka makka æuma k'anna ta ni-tna-msing tyni-æn alei ki ina ka gmail, ni-bana-vana teni jau-an ymmud ki na ringei-au.
S.TRANSL: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
那城裏有好些撒馬利亞人信了耶穌，因為那婦人作見證說：「他將我素來所行的一切事都給我說出來了。」

S.FORM: Irou ka irou-âto tyni-æn ta Samaritanen, ni-tmoumimia ty-ni-æn ki pæ-iliili-eih tyn neini-æn: ka ni-mæili hynna makka rouha ki wæi.
S.TRANSL: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
於是撒馬利亞人來見耶穌，求他在他們那裏住下，他便在那裏住了兩天。

S.FORM: Ka siouro mabatoung ta ni-tnamsing alei ki sou tyn.
S.TRANSL: And many more believed because of his own word;
因耶穌的話，信的人就更多了，

S.FORM: Ka ni k'ma ki ina, Assi-kame tna-msing hnyn alei ki na sou-oho, ra ni-ni-tna-mado-ni-an millingigh, ka kavanani-an ka missing ti atta ta ti Christus, ka Tama-Pakariàng ki ymmud ki næi.
S.TRANSL: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
便對婦人說：「現在我們信，不是因為你的話，是我們親自聽見了，知道這真是救世主。」

S.FORM: Ka sì æugh ki rouha ki wæ'i, ni-d'marang hynna, ka ni-sah-ka-qua mou-qua rou Galilea.
S.TRANSL: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
過了那兩天，耶穌離了那地方，往加利利去。

S.FORM: Ka ni-mæddo gmail ti Jesus ka äoussi ki louloug-an ta Ta-ma Mattæ'i tou pourough ti A-ma tyn.
S.TRANSL: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
因為耶穌自己作過見證說：「先知在本地是沒有人尊敬的。」

S.FORM: Irou ka mou-qua ta teni tou Galilæa ni-pa-hyh tatalagh tyni-æn ta ta'u ka makka Galilea, dou ni-kytt'an nein ta mamang ka na ringei tyn tou Jerusalem tou wæi ki ou-vavatoug-han: ka ni-lummad-appa ta neni tou ou-vava-toug-han.
S.TRANSL: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
到了加利利，加利利人既然看見他在耶路撒冷過節所行的一切事，就接待他，因為他們也是上去過節。

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-salikogh ta ti Jesus mou-qua tou Kana tou Ga-lilæa, ka ni-pa-hahala-un tyn ta raloum ki hala ki karæumættæh tou hynna. Ka akoumea hynna ta saat ka talalam ki Meisasou ka sibavau, ka pæi-a-lalam-men ki alak tyn ka pæræh tou Kapernaum.
S.TRANSL: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
耶穌又到了加利利的迦拿，就是他從前變水為酒的地方。有一個大臣，他的兒子在迦百農患病。

S.FORM: Teni rou ni-milligh ka lummad-den ti Jesus makka Judea mou-qua tou Galilæa ni-mou-qua tyni-æn ka ni-tmoumi-mi-en tyn tyni-æn kou'ou-rapag-auh tyn padarykkægh ta alak tyn ka pæræh: ka myhte æuh mihgynna-ua ta teni.
S.TRANSL: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
他聽見耶穌從猶太到了加利利，就來見他，求他下去醫治他的兒子，因為他兒子快要死了。

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus ty-ni-an, Heirou assi-moumi k'yt-t'an ta pou-kidi-en ki 'ou-rynh-gau-en appa ka ringei, assi-kamou tna-msing-ah.
S.TRANSL: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
耶穌就對他說：「若不看見神蹟奇事，你們總是不信。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma tyni-æn ta talalam ki Mei-sasou ka si-bavau, Meirang mou-rapag-â tou ouro ka assi-appa mapatei ta alak-au.
S.TRANSL: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
那大臣說：「先生，求你趁着我的孩子還沒有死就下去。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, 'Ou-qua, mæuag ta alak oho. Ka ni-tna-msing ta ta'u ki sou, ka pa-sousou-en ti Jesus tyni-æn; ka ni-'ou-qua tyn.
S.TRANSL: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
耶穌對他說：「回去吧，你的兒子活了！」那人信耶穌所說的話就回去了。

S.FORM: Irou ka 'ou-rapag-han tyn ni-dmoumma-doumma tyni-æn ta koungsia tyn, hmagnau k'ma, Mæuag ta alak oho.
S.TRANSL: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
正下去的時候，他的僕人迎見他，說他的兒子活了。

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-tmaligh neini-æn ki kidi ki tælei ki ni-tmyll-an ki maläam tyn: ka ni-k'ma ta neini tyni-æn, Y'ha tou ka pa-pyttou ki tælei ni-'ous-san ki æ̈yn-gyt tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
他就問甚麼時候見好的。他們說：「昨日未時熱就退了。」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-k'alang-en ki Rama ka d'lligh ki tælei k'anna ki ni-pasousou-en ti Jesus tyni-æn, Mæuag ta alak-oho: Ka ni-tna-msing ta teni tna-mado, tna-tmouk appa ki tallagh tyn.
S.TRANSL: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
他便知道這正是耶穌對他說「你兒子活了」的時候；他自己和全家就都信了。

S.FORM: Ka rarouha ki na pou-ka-kidi katta ni-he-lan ti Jesus pa-mut, dou lummad-ato makka Ju-dea mou-qua tou Galilæa.
S.TRANSL: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.
這是耶穌在加利利行的第二件神蹟，是他從猶太回去以後行的。
